thought.text: Key services are healthy. Now let me start the seeds that were skipped (their parents were aborted earlier):

reasoning_content:
The 4 key services are all returning 200. Next, check the seeds — project-logic-seed and formal-completeness-seed have become "Skipped" (because their parent process was previously interrupted). After these are ready, we need to start them. administrative-file-draft-seed has completed (this was one of the seeds that succeeded on the 2nd run!).

Let's check the seed status and start the skipped seeds.

action.command:
cd /workspace
for s in project-logic-seed formal-completeness-seed; do
  code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST "http://localhost:8080/process/start/$s")
  echo "start $s -> $code"
done
sleep 30
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/processes 2>/dev/null | /workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "
import sys, json
d = json.load(sys.stdin)['data']
for p in sorted(d, key=lambda x: x['name']):
    if 'seed' in p['name'] or p['name'] in ('jura-db','gesetzesbegruendung-db','frontend'):
        print(f\"{p['name']:30s} {p['status']:12s} exit={p['exit_code']} restarts={p['restarts']}\")
"
